reviews.comment: Provides documents that specify formatting requirements, essentially every single document is contradictory to the others. Does not seem to care one bit about your actual lab data, only the formatting. Grading is an absolute joke and completely arbitrary. Pretty sure everyone gets an A at least so there's that. Class is such a headache...

Doesn't provide clear guidelines or use clear language in lab manuals, but is very nitpicky about your work. Strict grading over grammar, word choice, etc. instead of technical information. Unnecessary. Lectures are a waste of time but you should go for your attendance. The labs were interesting, but I wouldn't want to have Alam for it again.
Dr. Alan doesn't provide clear instructions and guidelines. His lectures are not very helpful and he tends to take off points for no reason.
